concerns.text: FR-002 (Phylogenetic MICE) is not covered. T014a implements Median Substitution as a fallback and T014b implements Phylogenetic MICE, but T014a explicitly waives FR-002 if the tree is missing. No task exists to implement the *primary* Phylogenetic MICE logic when a tree IS available (T016c success path), leaving the core requirement unimplemented in the happy path.

FR-001 (Download NCBI RefSeq) is not covered. T011b attempts a fetch but immediately waives the requirement in Validation Mode and raises an error in Production Mode if it fails. No task exists to successfully parse and integrate real NCBI RefSeq data if it *were* available, effectively abandoning the FR-001 implementation path.

SC-005 (Validation against 15 independent real ABA genes) is not covered. T029 redefines the validation to check against synthetic 'hidden genes' or a proxy. No task exists to load the 15 real independent genes from a verified source and compare the top features against them, failing to satisfy the Spec's success criteria.

FR-009 (KNN Baseline with Phylogenetic Matrix) is not covered. T021 uses a synthetic matrix if a real one is missing and raises an error in Production Mode. No task exists to implement the KNN baseline using a *real* phylogenetic distance matrix if one were successfully fetched (T016c success), leaving the FR-009 implementation incomplete.

Tasks T049-T060 (README, Docker, CI/CD, Security, etc.) are tagged with generic 'Review Concern' labels but do not map to any specific FR/SC or Plan element. These appear to be scope creep or stale tags from a generic template, as the Spec and Plan focus strictly on the pipeline validation logic.
